regulation1089.source: Title enumerations that INSPIRE ETS test 'md datasets-and-series 1.10' (inspire-eu-validation/ets-repository v2026.1, commit 408644a9a91995d84d1ada3aac9905df12c44317) loads from https://inspire.ec.europa.eu/schemas/common/1.0/enums/enum_<lang>.xsd; hrv from enum_hrv.xsd.
regulation1089.matching: The ETS accepts a title when normalize-space(lower-case(title)) equals a listed title in any of its languages.
regulation1089.notes: No Irish text exists (enum_gle lists the English title). enum_hrv exists but the ETS does not load it. EUR-Lex titles differ (non-breaking spaces) and fail the ETS comparison.

concepts.en: Condensed matter physics (including formerly solid state physics, supercond.)

concepts.en: Fluids and plasma physics (including surface physics)
concepts.cs: Fyzika kapalin a plazmatu (zahrnuje fyziku povrchů)

concepts.en: Optics (including laser optics and quantum optics)
Electrochemistry (dry cells, batteries, fuel cells, corrosion metals, electrolysis)
concepts.cs: Elektrochemie (zahrnuje suché články, baterie, palivové články, korozní kovy, elektrolýzu)
Vědy o Zemi a související environmentální vědy

concepts.en: Biology (theoretical, mathematical, thermal, cryobiology, biological rhythm), evolutionary biology
concepts.cs: Biologie (teoretická, matematická, termální, kryobiologie, biologický rytmus), evoluční biologie

concepts.en: Construction engineering, municipal and structural engineering
Electrical engineering, electronic engineering, information engineering
Composites (including laminates, reinforced plastics, cermets, combined natural and synthetic fibre fabrics; filled composites)

concepts.en: Medical laboratory technology (including laboratory samples analysis, diagnostic technologies)
concepts.cs: Lékařské laboratorní technologie (laboratorní analýzy vzorků, diagnostické technologie)

concepts.en: Bioremediation, diagnostic biotechnologies (DNA chips and biosensing devices) in environmental management
concepts.cs: Bioléčba, diagnostické biotechnologie (zlomky DNA a biosenzory) v environmentálním managementu

concepts.en: Bioprocessing technologies (industrial processes relying on biological agents to drive the process) biocatalysis, fermentation

concepts.en: Critical care medicine and emergency medicine
Radiology, nuclear medicine and medical imaging

concepts.en: Integrative and complementary medicine (alternative practice systems)
concepts.cs: Celostní a alternativní medicína (alternativní praktické systémy)

concepts.en: Technologies involving the manipulation of cells, tissues, organs or the whole organism (assisted reproduction)

concepts.en: Biomaterials (as related to medical implants, devices, sensors)

GM technology (crops and livestock), livestock cloning, marker assisted selection, diagnostics (DNA chips and biosensing devices for the early/accurate detection of diseases) biomass feedstock production technologies, biopharming

Psychologie (zahrnuje vztahy mezi člověkem a strojem)
